As a result, the moment the NFC card left the rented room, the electricity would be abruptly cut off within ten seconds. This cumbersome process not only made it inconvenient for guests but also created unnecessary complications, especially when traveling with a partner.

All in all, my stay at the Mariot Taiz Hotel was far from satisfactory. The high prices, cramped rooms, additional charges for basic amenities, lackluster bathrooms, and hassle of using the elevator system profoundly affected my overall experience negatively. اذا ربحت على الزبون مره ، ممكن تخسره للابد","text_translated":"A regular customer of theirs, who sells rings, necklaces, and other family items, was sent yesterday to buy gold from them. I knew the price at the time I told him to stop by. We were shocked to find they sold it to him at a much higher price than the market rate! Why? Simply because I told him to buy directly from them; I didn't let him check with other shops. Honestly, it was my mistake not to let him double-check the price first. But it's also a big mistake for the shop to exploit a regular customer, especially one who is a loyal client. The hospital aims to provide comprehensive healthcare to more than 12,000 people in the area and surrounding villages, thus alleviating the suffering of residents due to the long distances to main hospitals.

The hospital consists of two floors and includes several specialized departments 💉, including an emergency department, outpatient clinics, operating rooms for minor surgeries, a pharmacy, a laboratory, and an X-ray room, in addition to inpatient wards and administrative offices.

The hospital is considered a valuable addition to healthcare services 💊 in Taiz and an important step towards improving the quality of medical care in underserved areas. It has been equipped with all necessary medical and office equipment.

To my dismay, the rooms were incredibly small, leaving very little space for comfort or relaxation, This lack of space significantly impacted my overall experience and made it feel rather claustrophobic.

Another major inconvenience was the hotel's policy of charging extra for the use of air conditioning, it baffles me that such a necessity in a hot climate like Taiz is treated as an additional package; the discomfort of having to pay extra for a basic amenity like AC was truly unacceptable and tarnished my impression of the hotel.

Adding insult to injury, the decision to cover the bed mattresses with leather was nothing short of a nightmare, the leather covering not only made the beds uncomfortably hot but also disrupted my sleep further, It seemed like a deliberate ploy to compel guests to opt for the additional AC package, extracting more money from their wallets.

Moreover, the bathrooms were disappointingly small and devoid of any unique features, they lacked the elegance and charm that one would expect from a renowned luxury hotel like Mariot Taiz. It felt like stepping into an average, run-of-the-mill bathroom rather than a lavish accommodation.

One of the most frustrating aspects was the complicated system of using the elevator. The hotel utilized NFC cards that had to be carried along with the room key in order to access the elevator. This meant that if I wanted to go anywhere, even just to the first floor, I had to take the NFC card with me. As a result, the moment the NFC card left the rented room, the electricity would be abruptly cut off within ten seconds. This cumbersome process not only made it inconvenient for guests but also created unnecessary complications, especially when traveling with a partner.

All in all, my stay at the Mariot Taiz Hotel was far from satisfactory. The high prices, cramped rooms, additional charges for basic amenities, lackluster bathrooms, and hassle of using the elevator system profoundly affected my overall experience negatively. --
المستشفى ودوره في المجتمع
مستشفى الرازي التخصصي تأسس ليكون مركزًا طبيًا متكاملًا يقدم خدماته لسكان مدينة راع والمناطق المجاورة. المستشفى يعمل وفق شعار "إنسان آمن.. طبيب أمين"، وهو شعار يعكس التزامه بتقديم رعاية صحية إنسانية قائمة على الثقة والاحترافية.
يُعتبر المستشفى وجهة رئيسية للمرضى الذين يبحثون عن خدمات طبية متقدمة دون الحاجة إلى السفر لمسافات طويلة، مما يخفف من معاناة الأهالي ويوفر لهم بيئة علاجية آمنة.
--
الخدمات الطبية
- الطوارئ: يعمل المستشفى على مدار 24 ساعة يوميًا لتقديم خدمات الطوارئ الفورية.
- العيادات الخارجية: تشمل تخصصات متعددة مثل الباطنية، الأطفال، النساء والولادة، والجراحة.
- الأقسام المتخصصة: يضم قسم الأشعة، العلاج الطبيعي، والعمليات الجراحية الدقيقة.
- الجراحات: من الجراحات العامة إلى التجميلية، مع فريق طبي مؤهل لتقديم أحدث الإجراءات الطبية.
هذه الخدمات تجعل المستشفى مركزًا متكاملًا يلبي احتياجات المرضى بمختلف الحالات.
--
الكادر الطبي والإدارة
يضم المستشفى نخبة من الأطباء ذوي الخبرة، إضافة إلى طاقم تمريض مدرّب على التعامل الإنساني والمهني مع المرضى. الإدارة تسعى باستمرار إلى تطوير الأقسام واستحداث خدمات جديدة لتوسيع نطاق الاستفادة، كما توفر فرص عمل لأكثر من 150 شخص من أبناء المجتمع المحلي.
--
الأثر الاجتماعي
وجود مستشفى الرازي التخصصي في مدينة راع له أثر مباشر على حياة السكان، حيث:
- يقلل من الحاجة للسفر إلى مدن بعيدة لتلقي العلاج.
- يساهم في رفع مستوى الوعي الصحي بين الأهالي.
- يخلق فرص عمل ويعزز التنمية المحلية.
